def follow(s,c,maxsteps=15000,speed=.7,snaps=False):
 pcom,Rcom=c.pose();last=-1
 for t in range(maxsteps):
  if s.goal_index==37 or s.failed:break
  gi=s.goal_index
  if gi!=last:
   print('GOAL',gi,'step',s.steps,'dist',s.goal_distance(),flush=True);last=gi
   if snaps and gi%5==0:c.snap('goal%02d'%gi)
  g=np.array(s.goals[gi]);Rg=Rot.from_quat(g[3:]).as_matrix()
  op=s.data.xpos[s._obj].copy();Ro=s.data.xmat[s._obj].reshape(3,3).copy();p,R=c.pose()
  delta=Rg@Ro.T
  pd=g[:3]+delta@(p-op);Rd=delta@R
  ep=pd-pcom;er=Rot.from_matrix(Rd@Rcom.T).as_rotvec()
  ep*=min(.15, .001*speed/(np.linalg.norm(ep)+1e-9));er*=min(.15,.012*speed/(np.linalg.norm(er)+1e-9))
  pcom+=ep;Rcom=Rot.from_rotvec(er).as_matrix()@Rcom
  q=c.ik(pcom,Rcom,n=15);s.step(q)
  if t%120==0:print('track',s.progress(),'op',op,'ep',np.linalg.norm(pd-p),flush=True)

+    "close": 1.2323351720132374,
+    "pip": 1.4399340222352361,
+    "dip": 0.786368557068271,
+    "thumb": [
+        1.5010755760841021,
+        -0.13405800816617158,
+        0.9617867239536795,
+        -0.14051422411002387,
+        1.5014245389204637,
+    ],
+}
+
+
+class Controller:
+    def __init__(self, session):
+        self.s = session
+        self.m = session.model
+        self.d = session.data
+        self.k = mujoco.MjData(self.m)
+        self.bid = self.m.body("palmleft_hand_C_MC").id
+
+    def pose(self):
+        return (
+            self.d.xpos[self.bid].copy(),
+            self.d.xmat[self.bid].reshape(3, 3).copy(),
+        )
+
+    def ik(self, p, rotation, n=15):
+        q = self.s.targets.copy()
+        self.k.qpos[:] = self.d.qpos
+        jp = np.zeros((3, self.m.nv))
+        jr = jp.copy()
+        for _ in range(n):
+            self.k.qpos[self.s._jq] = q
+            mujoco.mj_forward(self.m, self.k)
+            error = np.r_[
+                p - self.k.xpos[self.bid],
+                Rot.from_matrix(
+                    rotation @ self.k.xmat[self.bid].reshape(3, 3).T
+                ).as_rotvec(),
+            ]
+            if np.linalg.norm(error) < 1e-5:
+                break
+            mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m, self.k, jp, jr, self.bid)
+            jacobian = np.vstack([jp[:, :7], jr[:, :7]])
+            delta = jacobian.T @ np.linalg.solve(
+                jacobian @ jacobian.T + np.eye(6) * 1e-5, error
+            )
+            delta *= min(1, 0.12 / (np.max(np.abs(delta)) + 1e-9))
+            q[:7] = np.clip(
+                q[:7] + delta,
+                self.s.lower[:7] + 0.001,
+                self.s.upper[:7] - 0.001,
+            )
+        return q
+
+    def move(self, p, rotation, hand=None, steps=120):
+        p0, r0 = self.pose()
+        rv = Rot.from_matrix(rotation @ r0.T).as_rotvec()
+        h0 = self.s.targets[7:].copy()
+        for t in range(steps):
+            f = (t + 1) / steps
+            f = f * f * (3 - 2 * f)
+            q = self.ik(
+                p0 + (p - p0) * f, Rot.from_rotvec(rv * f).as_matrix() @ r0
+            )
+            if hand is not None:
+                q[7:] = h0 + (hand - h0) * f
+            self.s.step(q)
+
+    def hold(self, steps=60):
+        for _ in range(steps):
+            self.s.step(self.s.targets)
+
+
+def hand_pose(curl, thumb, pip, dip):
+    h = np.zeros(22)
+    h[:5] = thumb
+    for j in [5, 9, 13, 18]:
+        h[j:j + 4] = [curl, 0, pip, dip]
+    return h
+
+
+def grasp(s, c):
+    c.hold(20)
+    obj_pos = s.data.xpos[s._obj].copy()
+    obj_rot = s.data.xmat[s._obj].reshape(3, 3).copy()
+    y = -obj_rot[:, 0]
+    y[2] = 0
+    y /= np.linalg.norm(y)
+    x = np.array([0, 0, -1.0])
+    z = np.cross(x, y)
+    rotation = np.stack([x, y, z], axis=1)
+    rotation = rotation @ Rot.from_rotvec([0, GRASP["angle"], 0]).as_matrix()
+    p = obj_pos - rotation @ np.array([GRASP["dx"], GRASP["dy"], GRASP["dz"]])
+    pre = hand_pose(0, [-0.1, 0, 0, 0, 0], GRASP["pip"], GRASP["dip"])
+    closed = hand_pose(
+        GRASP["close"], GRASP["thumb"], GRASP["pip"], GRASP["dip"]
+    )
+    c.move(p + [0, 0, 0.11], rotation, pre, steps=150)
+    c.move(p, rotation, steps=180)
+    c.move(p, rotation, closed, steps=180)
+    c.hold(60)
+    c.move(p + [0, 0, 0.13], rotation, steps=180)
+    c.hold(60)
+
+
+def follow_goals(s, c):
+    p_command, r_command = c.pose()
+    last = -1
+    speed = 0.7
+    for _ in range(15000):
+        if s.goal_index == len(s.goals) or s.failed:
+            break
+        gi = s.goal_index
+        if gi != last:
+            print(f"Following goal {gi + 1}/{len(s.goals)} at step {s.steps}", flush=True)
+            last = gi
+        goal = np.array(s.goals[gi])
+        goal_rot = Rot.from_quat(goal[3:]).as_matrix()
+        obj_pos = s.data.xpos[s._obj].copy()
+        obj_rot = s.data.xmat[s._obj].reshape(3, 3).copy()
+        p, rotation = c.pose()
+
+        # Update the desired palm pose from the current grasp transform.
+        delta = goal_rot @ obj_rot.T
+        p_desired = goal[:3] + delta @ (p - obj_pos)
+        r_desired = delta @ rotation
+        ep = p_desired - p_command
+        er = Rot.from_matrix(r_desired @ r_command.T).as_rotvec()
+        ep *= min(0.15, 0.001 * speed / (np.linalg.norm(ep) + 1e-9))
+        er *= min(0.15, 0.012 * speed / (np.linalg.norm(er) + 1e-9))
+        p_command += ep
+        r_command = Rot.from_rotvec(er).as_matrix() @ r_command
+        s.step(c.ik(p_command, r_command))
+
+
+def main():
+    s = rcb_dtb.Session("/app/instance.json")
+    c = Controller(s)
+    s.record_start()
+    grasp(s, c)
+    follow_goals(s, c)
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    generated = {**s.progress(), "state_sha": s.state_sha(), "steps": s.steps}
+    assert generated["done"] and not generated["failed"], generated
+    assert actions.shape == (len(actions), 29)
+    assert len(actions) <= 360000 and np.isfinite(actions).all()
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUTPUT / "trajectory.npz", meta=generated)
+
+    # The benchmark replay resets the scene to the frozen start state.
+    replayed = s.replay(actions)
+    assert replayed["done"] and not replayed["failed"], replayed
+    assert replayed["state_sha"] == generated["state_sha"], (generated, replayed)
+    result = {"generated": generated, "replayed": replayed, "shape": list(actions.shape)}
+    (OUTPUT / "verification.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
+    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
+
+
